page.notes: The Syriac lines (top and the block after "loquitur;") could not be read letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible with estimated letter counts; the line counts follow the scan. The Latin "tobis" is printed that way (probably for "vobis") and is left as printed. The Latin italic passage is a quotation from the Fathers of the Church that follows the Syriac lines. No running head, catchword or marginal notes are printed on this page. "Rr" at the foot is the gathering signature.
